    static class TrainSolver {
        private int n;
        private int m;
        private int s;
        private long t;

        private void step() {
            int curJump = (int) ((t--) % n);
            int direction = s < m ? 1 : -1;
            s += direction * curJump;
            s %= n;
            if (s < 0) s += n;

        private void fullLoop() {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) step();
        }

        public void solve(int testNumber, InputReader in, PrintWriter out) {

            m = in.nextInt();
            s = in.nextInt() - 1;
            t = in.nextLong();

            long[] lastSeen = new long[n];
            Arrays.fill(lastSeen, -1);
            while (t != 0) {
                fullLoop();
                if (lastSeen[s] != -1) {
                    long interval = lastSeen[s] - t;
                    t %= interval;
                    break;
                } else {

        }
    }

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        ManualScanner in = new ManualScanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        MetroSolver solver = new MetroSolver();
        solver.solve(in, out);
        out.close();
    }

    static class MetroSolver {
        private int n, m, s;
        private long t;

        private void advance() {
            int jump = (int) (t % n);
            t--;
            int dir = s < m ? 1 : -1;
            s = Math.floorMod(s + dir * jump, n);
        }

        private void advanceCycle() {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) advance();
        }

        void solve(ManualScanner in, PrintWriter out) {
            n = in.nextInt();
            m = in.nextInt();
            s = in.nextInt() - 1;
            t = in.nextLong();
            while (t % n != 0) advance();

            long[] memory = new long[n];
            Arrays.fill(memory, -1L);
            while (t != 0) {
                advanceCycle();
                if (memory[s] != -1L) {
                    long interval = memory[s] - t;
                    t %= interval;
                    break;
                }
                memory[s] = t;
            }
            while (t != 0) advance();
            out.println(s + 1);
        }
    }

    static class ManualScanner {
        private InputStream in;

        ManualScanner(InputStream in) {
            this.in = in;
        }

        private int readRaw() throws IOException {
            return in.read();
        }

        private boolean isDelimiter(int c) {
            return c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\f' || c == ',';
        }

        String nextToken() {
            try {
                int c = readRaw();
                while (c != -1 && isDelimiter(c)) c = readRaw();
                if (c == -1) return null;
                StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
                while (c != -1 && !isDelimiter(c)) {
                    sb.append((char) c);
                    c = readRaw();
                }
                return sb.toString();
            } catch (IOException e) {
                throw new RuntimeException(e);
            }
        }

        int nextInt() {
            return Integer.parseInt(nextToken());
        }

        long nextLong() {
            return Long.parseLong(nextToken());
        }
    }
}
